# `env` Crate

Utilities for reading and parsing environment variables.

## Functions

- `get_required`: Get a variable or return an error.
- `get_or_default`: Get a variable or return a default value.
- `get_parsed`: Get and parse a variable or return an error.
- `get_parsed_or_default`: Get and parse a variable or return a default value.
- `get_bool`: Get a boolean variable with flexible parsing.
